Entry restricted. The masters of all vessels over 500GT or 40m LOA are required to seek permission from the Regional Harbourmaster before entering the area. For contact details refer to the Harbourmasters list in the New Zealand Nautical Almanac.

Motuihe Channel Fast Passenger Ferry Lane

Anchoring prohibited. Fishing prohibited. No vessel may impede the passage of a fast passenger ferry (identified by an orange flashing light) when within the lane. No vessel may anchor or fish within the lane or its approaches.
Fishing prohibited. All marine life and habitats totally protected. No fishing, netting, taking or killing of marine life. Contact Department of Conservation for further information.
